notes: EmberMaps 1.14 integrated preview: richer 2D streets, optional geographic land/water/building layers (schema 2), a road-graph offline draft preview, and a switchable tilted perspective map view. Existing map regions and EmberOS apps are preserved. Offline drafts do not validate one-way or turn restrictions and cannot start GPS guidance. Full 3D buildings, verified offline turn-by-turn navigation, traffic and convoy are not included.
